strings.name: Cristina Junqueira
strings.role: Nubank co-founder · Group chief growth officer and US CEO
strings.summary: Cristina Junqueira co-founded Nubank with David Vélez and Edward Wible, helping build the business from Brazilian digital credit cards before taking responsibility for group growth and US operations. She is not the group CEO. US products have launched through a partner bank; the company’s own bank-charter process is separate.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Co-founding and individual contributions, group and US roles, and product launch and final bank-charter approval are distinguished. Birth year only.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Nubank and helped build digital banking products and the organisation, influencing Latin American fintech and women’s entrepreneurship.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Holds an engineering bachelor’s and a master’s from the University of São Paulo; completed Kellogg’s One-Year MBA in 2008.
strings.facts.f2.label: Early career
strings.facts.f2.value: Worked in consulting and in consumer credit, cards and marketing at Itaú Unibanco.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Digital finance entrepreneurship
strings.highlights.h1.text: Develops mobile financial services with co-founders and teams; product technologies and market achievements are not attributed to her alone.
strings.highlights.h2.title: US expansion
strings.highlights.h2.text: Leads Nu’s US business, providing banking services through Lead Bank in 2026; the partnership is separate from Nubank’s own charter process.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Launches US operations
strings.timeline.t1.text: Presents products as Nu US CEO; banking services and credit cards are provided by partner Lead Bank, not proof of final approval for Nu’s own bank.
strings.timeline.t2.title: US bank application receives conditional approval
strings.timeline.t2.text: Nu announces preliminary conditional OCC approval for a new bank, with conditions and other regulatory requirements still to satisfy.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Submits US bank application
strings.timeline.t3.text: Applies to the OCC to establish Nubank, N.A.; Junqueira is named in the application materials. Filing is not authorisation to operate.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Becomes group chief growth officer
strings.timeline.t4.text: The official management biography dates this role from this month; it is distinct from group CEO.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Company lists in New York
strings.timeline.t5.text: Nu enters the NYSE through an IPO, a company-financing milestone rather than personal income.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Credit card launches to the public
strings.timeline.t6.text: The official timeline dates the public card launch to this month; the first transaction in April was a separate earlier milestone.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Co-founds Nubank
strings.timeline.t7.text: Starts the venture in São Paulo with David Vélez and Edward Wible, preserving all three founders’ contributions.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completes Kellogg MBA
strings.timeline.t8.text: Finishes the One-Year MBA and enters bank management, moving from consulting into finance.
